snippet.title: Rare pieces in The Bone Museum part 812￼
snippet.description:
Step into a realm where history and science converge at The Bone Museum in the heart of Brooklyn, New York. 💀🏛️

In our latest video, we’re spotlighting just a few of the extraordinary specimens in our collection, including:

💀 A rare Maison Tramond anatomical preparation dating to approximately 1878, incorporating authentic human skeletal remains and showcasing 19th-century medical craftsmanship.

🦴 The skeletal effects of scurvy, a disease caused by severe vitamin C deficiency.

🩻 A hemivertebra, a congenital abnormality in which one side of a vertebra develops incompletely.

🦴 A malunited femoral fracture, featuring approximately five inches of displacement following improper healing.

And these are just a few of the remarkable bones featured in our latest tour!

Each piece offers a fascinating glimpse into human anatomy, skeletal pathology, and the history of medicine.

And, of course, no tour of The Bone Museum would be complete without a special cameo from Bone Jovi, our beloved museum cat! 🐈‍⬛🖤

Come discover these incredible pieces for yourself at The Bone Museum in Brooklyn, New York!

snippet.title: 97 Tahun Dikuasai Asing, Blok Rokan Akhirnya Direbut Balik 🇮🇩 #terimakasihjokowi #shorts
snippet.description:
🇮🇩 Blok Rokan: hampir seratus tahun, minyak di bumi Riau dikelola perusahaan Amerika.

🛢️ Tahun 1924 ahli geologi perusahaan minyak Amerika datang ke Riau. Di sana ditemukan ladang Minas dan Duri. Puncaknya tahun 1970-an, hampir 1 juta barel minyak per hari. Selama 70 tahun, Blok Rokan menyumbang rata-rata hampir separuh minyak Indonesia.

🤝 Saat kontraknya akan habis, Chevron ingin memperpanjang dan menawarkan teknologi baru. 31 Juli 2018 keputusan diumumkan: Blok Rokan diserahkan ke Pertamina.

⏰ 9 Agustus 2021 pukul 00.01 WIB, Blok Rokan resmi dikelola Pertamina. Kata Pak Jokowi: "Kita ditantang untuk membuktikan kemampuan kita."

📈 Hasilnya, kata Pak Jokowi di Dumai (1 Juni 2024), produksi naik dari 130 ribu menjadi 162 ribu barel per hari, dan Blok Rokan kini 100 persen dikelola anak-anak bangsa sendiri.

Kalau bangga sama Pak Jokowi, follow dan subscribe biar tidak ketinggalan video berikutnya. Terima kasih, Pak Jokowi.
